eval_feedback.overall: Strong performance on four of five criteria. The response correctly uses an acceptance-review task as the gate, applies numeric priorities throughout, explains the needs:discussion + blocked pattern with a concrete example and summary table, and consistently uses the --body-file - heredoc pattern. The only miss is the pre-execution orientation: the skill expects the agent to surface bd ready and bd blocked before issuing any creation commands so the planner knows what already exists and what is currently blocked. Adding two lines at the top ('Run bd ready to see available work; run bd blocked to check existing blockers before creating new issues') would close this gap.

suggestions.reason: The response could be improved by adding a brief 'Before creating issues' preamble that runs bd ready and bd blocked to ground the plan in current project state, as the skill prescribes this as a standard orientation step before any new work is created.
